entries.text_de:
Rom, Vatican, Christina regina 587, Papier, 16. Jh. Im Huntingdon (ed. Arnold p. 188) f. 99 v. In Cn, u. S. 612. Vgl. Ip Hunt. Hinter Hunt. Liber XII, f. 193b Tripartita: Wl art, u. S. 486; f. 194b Rubrikenliste, u. S. 670; f. 195b ECf retr, u. S. 627; f. 205b Geneal. Normannica; f. 207 dahinter die Lb schliessenden Verse o. S. xxxiii, also aus der Gruppe Ra Rc Vi Gr.

Im 19. Jh. ward Va copirt in Ry.
entries.text_en:
Rome, Vatican, Christina regina 587, paper, 16th century. Within Huntingdon (ed. Arnold p. 188) f. 99 v. In Cn, below, p. 612. Cf. Ip Hunt. After Hunt. Book XII, f. 193b Tripartita: Wl art, below, p. 486; f. 194b list of rubrics, below, p. 670; f. 195b ECf retr, below, p. 627; f. 205b Geneal. Normannica; f. 207 after that the verses that close Lb, above, p. xxxiii, hence from the group Ra Rc Vi Gr.

In the 19th century Va was copied in Ry.

others.text: O’Brien (2003): in O’Brien’s family tree Va is paired with a Huntingdon manuscript he calls Ba.
